mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('attachmentId',ordered.attachment_id, 'displayName',ordered.display_name,'sizeBytes',ordered.size_bytes, 'mediaKind',ordered.media_kind,'mediaType',ordered.media_type)) FROM (SELECT json_extract(block.value,'$.attachmentId') AS attachment_id, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN '附件不可用' ELSE a.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.size_bytes END AS size_bytes, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN 'binary' ELSE lower(a.media_kind) END AS media_kind, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN 'application/octet-stream' ELSE a.media_type END AS media_type FROM json_each(pending_inputs.content_json) block LEFT JOIN pending_input_attachments pia ON pia.input_id=pending_inputs.input_id AND pia.attachment_id=json_extract(block.value,'$.attachmentId') LEFT JOIN attachments a ON a.attachment_id=pia.attachment_id WHERE json_extract(block.value,'$.kind')='attachment' ORDER BY CAST(block.key AS INTEGER)) ordered),json_array())
mapper.select: SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at,x.updated_at, x.completed_at,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_expected_thread_revision,x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, x.input_queue_revision,x.accepting_inputs, NULL AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json FROM turns x LEFT JOIN turn_change_sets c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at,x.updated_at, x.completed_at,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_expected_thread_revision,x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, x.input_queue_revision,x.accepting_inputs, NULL AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json FROM turns x LEFT JOIN turn_change_sets c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY x.turn_sequence

SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at,x.updated_at, x.completed_at,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_expected_thread_revision,x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, x.input_queue_revision,x.accepting_inputs, t.revision AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json FROM turns x JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=x.thread_id LEFT JOIN turn_change_sets c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.turn_id=#{turnId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id<>#{turnId} LIMIT 1)
SELECT turn_id AS turnId,schema_version AS schemaVersion,state_json AS stateJson FROM turn_execution WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT x.turn_id AS turnId,x.thread_id AS threadId,t.workspace_id AS workspaceId,w.root_path AS rootPath, x.mutation_version AS turnMutationVersion,t.revision AS threadRevision, e.schema_version AS schemaVersion,e.state_json AS stateJson, (SELECT m.blocks_json FROM messages m WHERE m.turn_id=x.turn_id AND m.role='USER' ORDER BY m.ordinal LIMIT 1) AS originalUserBlocksJson, c.origin AS internalOrigin,c.context_json AS internalContextJson, CASE WHEN t.title_source='PLACEHOLDER' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turns p WHERE p.thread_id=x.thread_id AND p.turn_sequence<x.turn_sequence ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS provisionalTitleEligible FROM turns x JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=x.thread_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.workspace_id=t.workspace_id JOIN turn_execution e ON e.turn_id=x.turn_id LEFT JOIN turn_internal_context c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.turn_id=#{turnId} AND x.state='SUSPENDED' AND x.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE turns SET state='QUEUED',mutation_version=mutation_version+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND thread_id=#{threadId} AND state='SUSPENDED' AND mutation_version=#{expectedTurnMutationVersion} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM threads t WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.revision=#{expectedThreadRevision}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turns p WHERE p.thread_id=#{threadId} AND p.state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND p.turn_sequence<(SELECT turn_sequence FROM turns WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}))

UPDATE turns SET state='CANCELLED',mutation_version=mutation_version+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt}, accepting_inputs=0,input_queue_revision=input_queue_revision+1, completed_at=#{occurredAt},terminal_summary='Cancelled while suspended',error_code='CANCELLED', error_message='The suspended Turn was cancelled before execution resumed.' WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND thread_id=#{threadId} AND state='SUSPENDED' AND mutation_version=#{expectedTurnMutationVersion} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM threads t WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.revision=#{expectedThreadRevision})

UPDATE turns SET state='SUSPENDED',mutation_version=mutation_version+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt}, cancel_requested_at=NULL,completed_at=NULL,error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND thread_id=#{threadId} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') AND mutation_version=#{expectedTurnMutationVersion} AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM threads t WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.revision=#{expectedThreadRevision}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_execution e WHERE e.turn_id=#{turnId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND state='SUSPENDED'
mapper.update: UPDATE turn_execution SET schema_version=#{schemaVersion},state_json=#{stateJson} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal)+1,1) FROM messages WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}
SELECT message_id,turn_id,ordinal,role,blocks_json,created_at FROM messages WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY ordinal

SELECT m.message_id,m.turn_id,m.ordinal,m.role,m.blocks_json,m.created_at FROM messages m JOIN timeline_messages t ON t.item_id=m.message_id AND t.thread_id=m.thread_id AND t.turn_id=m.turn_id WHERE m.thread_id=#{threadId} AND m.turn_id=#{turnId} AND m.role='USER' AND t.message_kind='USER_INPUT' ORDER BY m.ordinal LIMIT 1
SELECT call_id,state,revision,ordinal,tool_name,side_effect FROM tools WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tools SET state=#{state},presentation_json=#{presentationJson},artifact_id=#{artifactId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
UPDATE tools SET presentation_json=#{presentationJson},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tools WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
SELECT call_id FROM tools WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING') ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.update: UPDATE tools SET state=#{state}, presentation_json=json_set(presentation_json,'$.status',#{presentationStatus}, '$.outputPreview',#{outputPreview}), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT artifact_id,content,character_length FROM tool_artifacts WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId}
SELECT approval_id,decision,expires_at FROM approvals WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND approval_id=#{approvalId}
SELECT approval_id,decision,expires_at FROM approvals WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC,approval_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE approvals SET decision='DENY',resolved_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND decision IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_inputs(input_id,thread_id,turn_id,kind,content_json,state,validation_status, input_revision,priority_sequence, created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{inputId},#{threadId},#{turnId},#{kind},#{contentJson},'PENDING','PENDING',1, CASE WHEN #{kind}='STEERING' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(priority_sequence)+1,1) FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}) ELSE NULL END,#{occurredAt},#{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT input_id,thread_id,turn_id,kind,content_json,validation_status,issue_error_code, issue_message,issue_retryable,input_revision,created_at, AS attachments_json FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING' AND kind=#{kind} ORDER BY CASE kind WHEN 'STEERING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN kind='STEERING' THEN priority_sequence ELSE input_sequence END LIMIT 1

SELECT input_id,thread_id,turn_id,kind,content_json,validation_status,issue_error_code, issue_message,issue_retryable,input_revision,created_at, AS attachments_json FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING' ORDER BY CASE kind WHEN 'STEERING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN kind='STEERING' THEN priority_sequence ELSE input_sequence END

SELECT input_id,thread_id,turn_id,kind,content_json,validation_status,issue_error_code, issue_message,issue_retryable,input_revision,created_at, AS attachments_json FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND input_id=#{inputId} AND state='PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inputCount,COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(content_json AS BLOB))),0) AS totalBytes FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(priority_sequence)+1,1) FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
mapper.update: UPDATE turns SET input_queue_revision=input_queue_revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND input_queue_revision=#{expectedQueueRevision}
